root_cause: Router preflight unconditionally upserted a snapshot and required assetMaterialized before preserving CLAIMED. An async OpenArt job has no asset URL while running; real complete RPC therefore failed MEDIA_JOB_NOT_CLAIMED:WAITING_ASSET. A worker may also claim between read and write.
intervention: Preserve CLAIMED/GENERATING before writing. Existing-row updates use id+updated_at CAS; insert contention and stale snapshots return typed retry before obligation mutation; obligation projection also requires its original updated_at and no external provider ID. No change to proof, provider or publication authority. Preserve explicit bounded generation-exhaustion/provider failure instead of reopening generation.
